found.label: Key fields found
found.detail: The seven key fields are patient, age, date, hospital, doctor, diagnosis and vitals. A field counts when it is actually written on the script; nothing is filled in from elsewhere.

review.label: Entries to check
review.detail: An entry is tagged CHECK when the handwriting can't be read with confidence. These are the entries worth a second look against the scan.

case.label: Case type
case.detail: Stat/IV emergency orders → Acute / Emergency. A long-term condition written in the diagnosis (cancer, schizophrenia, diabetes, hypertension, radiculopathy, gout…) → Chronic. Otherwise by the longest medicine duration: 90+ days Chronic, 15–89 days Sub-acute, under 15 days Acute.

refill.label: Refill candidate
refill.formula: any medicine runs a month or longer
refill.detail: At least one medicine is prescribed for 4 weeks or more, or continuously.

poly.label: Multiple medicines (5+)
poly.detail: Counts medicines only — tests and supportive-care items don't count.

diagnostics.label: Lab-test opportunity
diagnostics.formula: a test is ordered, or a lab result is written on the script
diagnostics.detail: Tests ordered on the script, or lab results (e.g. uric acid, creatinine). Routine vitals such as BP, pulse, SpO₂ or weight don't count.
